name: Park Ridge Summer Camp
description_short: Borough morning camp for children entering kindergarten through grade 7. Mondays and Fridays are at the Park Ridge Municipal Pool, most other mornings at Memorial/Davies Field, with three Wednesdays at Montvale Lanes and one morning at a Westwood movie theater.
notes: Mornings only: 9:30 to 11:30 at the pool on Mondays and Fridays, 8:30 to 11:45 at Memorial/Davies Field on Tuesdays, Thursdays and two Wednesdays (July 8 and 22), 9:30 to 11:30 at Montvale Lanes on three Wednesdays (July 1, 15 and 29), and Westwood Cinemas on July 23. Open to all; space is limited. The page gives no price.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 'Park Ridge Summer Camp, June 29th to July 31, 2026. Open to all incoming Kindergarten through 7th grade.' Ages derived from grades (K to 7 gives 5 to 13). The linked Day Camp Calendar PDF did not load.

Researched by Claude from this page. Park Ridge Municipal Pool, 123 Colony Ave., Park Ridge, NJ 07656, where camp meets on Mondays and Fridays. Street left out because most days are at Memorial/Davies Field, whose address the site doesn't give.

for_andrew: The discovery note said 8 to 4:30, but the camp's page shows mornings only (about 8:30 to 11:45 at most). I went with the page.
